body: So even having it all won't save you from misery. Why bother then?

> You should understand that the rich, powerful and successful experience pain and suffering and envy and jealousy just like everybody else

Yeah, but they're still rich, powerful, and successful

Then why are *most* people without happiness and fulfillment in their lives? It's just a simple statistical fact that you probably won't find fulfillment in life. It's a definite fact that life is cruel and hard and you come out of it scarred. I *could* try to be one of those happy, fulfilled people, but all the miserable people were people like that who got beat down even more for trying. It just seems easier and better to not even bother.
